summary: getDownstreamTypes and getUpstreamTypes implemented cleanly via indexOf/slice with spread to ensure fresh array returns. Per-spec table coverage complete (all 8 combinations).
Both functions are correctly typed as returning PipelineType[], not string[], which preserves the discriminated union type safety downstream.
Immutability tests (push mutation + re-query) added — a best-practice pattern that guards against future accidental reference returns.
Minor: getUpstreamTypes has no index === -1 guard unlike getDownstreamTypes. TypeScript makes this unreachable but the inconsistency is a non-blocking observation.

comments.note: getDownstreamTypes has a defensive guard for index === -1 (returns []) but getUpstreamTypes does not — for an unknown type, slice(0, -1) would return all-but-last instead of []. TypeScript makes this statically unreachable, but the defensive handling is inconsistent. Non-blocking given the type safety, but worth aligning in a follow-up.

Immutability tests (push then re-query) are a valuable pattern — they guard against future refactors that accidentally return a shared reference rather than a fresh slice. Recommend adopting this test pattern for all future slice-returning helpers in pipeline-maps.ts.
